response.justification: Candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer but has almost no relevant background for this role: minimal C++ (brief, years-old work at National Instruments), no Windows-platform development, no SQL Server/Oracle depth, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience. His career is centered on web/full-stack, DLang, and general backend systems, none of which map to the mandatory requirements.
strengths: Highly experienced senior/staff-level engineer with broad technical range
Strong communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
Demonstrated software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
concerns: Virtually no recent or substantial C++ experience (only briefly at National Instruments, ~6 months, ended 2015)
No evidence of Windows platform development experience
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure, and no strong SQL Server/Oracle experience

key_factors.factor: No capital markets/fixed income domain experience
No Windows platform or SQL Server/Oracle depth
